title: Issue#7867: Removed the access restriction for procedures in the confirmation window.
summary: The Shopify Add Item Confirm page now allows unrestricted access to its procedures, eliminating the need for app developers to create a copy of the page.
key_points: Access restriction for procedures in page 30144 was removed
Page has no source table and is a standard dialog type
Enables use without requiring a copy object in extensions
Related to facade codeunit procedures being added separately
quote: This change allows us to use the confirmation window without any restrictions, eliminating the need to add a copy object to our app.
